title: FivePhase
description: The five-phase interaction matrix (modeled on the Wuxing five-element cycle): the single source of truth for how phased effects interact. Phases tag effects (effect.schema.json#/properties/phase); the cycles here define what happens when two phased effects meet. This is the relational layer and is orthogonal to the color magic schools — it changes how effects interact, not which skill governs them.

phases.description: The five phases. Exactly five, one per id in schema.json#/definitions/phase.

cycles.description: The relationship cycles. Each cycle is a set of directed edges sharing one interaction kind, multiplier, and resolution rule.

interaction.description: What firing this cycle does: amplify (generating, boost), suppress (overcoming, reduce/dispel), drain (weakening, sap), backlash (insulting, conditional reversal).

affects.description: Which participant the magnitudeMultiplier modifies. An edge 'from → to' is the canonical Wuxing relation 'from acts upon to'; 'actor' = the from-phase party, 'recipient' = the to-phase party. Engines map a standing phase + an incoming phase onto from/to by matching the edge.

magnitudeMultiplier.description: Reference multiplier applied to the affected participant's magnitude (and/or duration) when this edge fires. >1 boosts, <1 reduces, 0 fully dispels. Tunable per game.

condition.description: Optional gating condition for imbalance cycles (e.g. backlash fires only when the actor's magnitude exceeds the recipient's).

edges.description: Directed phase relationships. 'from' acts upon 'to' in the canonical Wuxing reading for this cycle.
